# Copilot / code-assist instructions

Read `project.md` (canonical engineering rules) and `AGENTS.md` (operational
quick reference) before every meaningful task. `project.md` wins over this file; an
explicit maintainer instruction and `docs/CONTRACT.md` invariants win over both.

If the maintainer invokes **“leader go”** or **“leader mode”**, read the maintainer's
local, untracked orchestration brief if one is present in the working tree. If it is
absent, ask; do not invent a process. Internal orchestration material is not part of
this public repo.
